# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this repository, please report it responsibly by emailing robson.sutton@hotmail.co.uk instead of using the public issue tracker.

Please include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix (if applicable)

We take security seriously and will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and work on a fix.

## Security Best Practices

- Keep dependencies updated
- Do not commit sensitive data (API keys, tokens, passwords)
- Use signed commits when possible
- Follow secure coding practices
- Report vulnerabilities responsibly

## Supported Versions

Currently maintained and receiving security updates:
- Latest stable version

## Disclosure Timeline

- Reports will be investigated within 48 hours
- Fixes will be prioritized based on severity
- Public disclosure will follow after a patch is available
